versionPolicy: Use versions listed in recommendedVersion when present; otherwise use latest stable release.
source: The core layers (framework, bundler, UI components, tests) are defined by allowedStack in plugins/golive-gate/data/build-contract.json and are only pointed to here. Design tokens and design language stay BLUE DLS for every stack. This radar fills remaining concerns and carries the legacy `hold` ring for Vue 3 projects. Adapted from https://github.com/acme-org/tech-radar/blob/main/frontend.json.

entries.name: Svelte
entries.description: Frontend framework, with TypeScript (allowedStack).

entries.name: svelte-check
entries.description: Type and diagnostics checker for Svelte (allowedStack).

entries.name: @acme/rnd-svelte.*
entries.description: UI component set (allowedStack), via ui-dev:rnd-svelte-implementor. Themed by BLUE tokens.

entries.name: Bun (package manager)
entries.description: Package manager (allowedStack). `bun install --frozen-lockfile`; bun.lock is the lockfile.

entries.name: @acme/blue-design-tokens
entries.description: Design foundation for every stack (allowedStack designSystem): BLUE DLS colour, typography and spacing tokens are the visual source of truth; never hand-roll values BLUE already defines.

entries.name: Vue 3
entries.description: Legacy only (project Vibe Start before 2026-10-07) or tech-architect approval. Svelte is the framework

entries.name: TypeScript
entries.description: Language for Svelte applications (allowedStack).

entries.name: JavaScript / ES6+
entries.description: Modern JavaScript baseline when TypeScript is not yet adopted in a module.

entries.name: HTML 5
entries.description: Standard markup for web applications.

entries.name: CSS 3
entries.description: Default styling approach.

entries.name: SCSS
entries.description: CSS preprocessor for component and layout styles.

entries.name: BLUE DLS Vue 3 (component package)
entries.description: Legacy only (project Vibe Start before 2026-10-07) or tech-architect approval. Only the Vue 3 component package is legacy; use @acme/rnd-svelte.*. BLUE tokens, icons and patterns stay mandatory

entries.name: BLUE Pattern Library - Collaborative Components
entries.description: Design foundation for every stack: use published BLUE collaborative components/patterns when the required pattern is available.

entries.name: BLUE Icon
entries.description: Design foundation for every stack: use the standard BLUE icon library instead of custom or third-party icon sets.

entries.name: Vue 2
entries.description: End-of-life and not allowed for new frontend work. Use Svelte with @acme/rnd-svelte.*.

entries.name: BLUE DLS Vue 2
entries.description: Legacy Vue 2 design system. Use BLUE tokens with @acme/rnd-svelte.*.

entries.name: React
entries.description: Not allowed for new frontend work. Use Svelte with @acme/rnd-svelte.*.

entries.name: Angular
entries.description: Not allowed for new frontend work. Use Svelte with @acme/rnd-svelte.*.

entries.name: Nuxt.js
entries.description: Not allowed for new frontend work. Use Svelte with Vite; request a tech-architect approval if SSR is required.

entries.name: Vue Router
entries.description: Legacy only (project Vibe Start before 2026-10-07) or tech-architect approval. Use the Svelte routing provided by the rnd-svelte implementor

entries.name: @tanstack/vue-query
entries.description: Legacy only (project Vibe Start before 2026-10-07) or tech-architect approval. Use Svelte-native data loading with window.fetch / Eden treaty

entries.name: Pinia
entries.description: Legacy only (project Vibe Start before 2026-10-07) or tech-architect approval. Use Svelte stores/runes

entries.name: Vuex
entries.description: Legacy Vue state management. Use Svelte stores/runes.

entries.name: Vite
entries.description: Build tool and dev server for Svelte projects (allowedStack).

entries.name: Webpack
entries.description: Do not use for new projects. Use Vite.

entries.name: Vitest
entries.description: Legacy only (project Vibe Start before 2026-10-07) or tech-architect approval. Use bun test for units and Playwright for browser journeys

entries.name: @vue/test-utils
entries.description: Legacy only (project Vibe Start before 2026-10-07) or tech-architect approval. Use bun test / Playwright

entries.name: Jest 28+
entries.description: Legacy only (project Vibe Start before 2026-10-07) or tech-architect approval. Use bun test

entries.name: Jest 23
entries.description: Legacy Jest - use bun test.

entries.name: ESLint
entries.description: Linting and code quality enforcement.

entries.name: Playwright
entries.description: Browser automation for integration and E2E tests (allowedStack; the only sanctioned second runner).

entries.name: window.fetch
entries.description: Use native fetch for HTTP calls. Do not add axios.

entries.name: axios
entries.description: Do not use — replace with window.fetch.

entries.name: dayjs
entries.description: Date parsing and formatting.

entries.name: moment.js
entries.description: Too heavy — use dayjs.

entries.name: jQuery
entries.description: Do not use - use Svelte and modern DOM APIs.

entries.name: GraphQL (client)
entries.description: Prefer REST + OpenAPI for new integrations unless explicitly approved.

entries.name: OpenAPI Spec (OAS)
entries.description: Contract for API clients and code generation.

entries.name: NPM
entries.description: Legacy only (project Vibe Start before 2026-10-07) or tech-architect approval. Use Bun as package manager

entries.name: PNPM
entries.description: Legacy only (project Vibe Start before 2026-10-07) or tech-architect approval. Use Bun as package manager

entries.name: Yarn
entries.description: Do not use for new projects.

entries.name: Sass (dart-sass)
entries.description: SCSS compilation — use dart-sass, not node-sass.

entries.name: node-sass
entries.description: Deprecated — use dart-sass.

entries.name: Docker
entries.description: Containerize the application (the frontend build is served by the backend).

entries.name: NGINX
entries.description: Legacy only (project Vibe Start before 2026-10-07) or tech-architect approval. Static serving of the build output is done by the backend (dist/)

entries.name: GCS
entries.description: Static asset hosting when deploying to GCP.

entries.name: Lazy-load / Lazy-rendering
entries.description: Code-split routes and defer off-screen rendering.

entries.name: Web Core Vitals
entries.description: Measure LCP, INP, and CLS for production pages.

entries.name: FE Integration test
entries.description: Prefer Playwright integration tests over shallow unit snapshots.

entries.name: PWA
entries.description: Service worker and offline-capable patterns when product requires it.

entries.name: Micro Frontend (iframe)
entries.description: Avoid iframe-based composition for new work — prefer module federation or npm packages.
